objs.name: document
objs.description: A controlled information object that can be created, edited, reviewed, released, and archived within the P&R Management system. Documents have a lifecycle including versioning, status management, and validity periods.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code assigned to a document for identification purposes

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document in its lifecycle such as editing, review, released, or archived

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date when the document becomes valid

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date when the document validity expires

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Duration for which a document remains valid before requiring validity check

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or objects related to this document

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Information technology applications associated with or referenced by the document

attributes.name: relevant_companies_or_areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Geographic, organizational, or functional scope of the document's applicability

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document type that documents locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: A document type that describes specific procedures and process sequences with details and responsible persons

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document type that details specific work steps, test instructions, and criteria for sub-processes

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with the system in various roles including author, reviewer, releaser, translator, or reader

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Assigned function such as Author, Co-author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, or Reader

attributes.name: authorization
attributes.description: Access rights and permissions assigned to the user for specific documents

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned with specific roles and authorizations for document access and workflow participation

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Identifier of the user group such as Reader - Document Management or Archive group

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of permissions granted to group members

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document supplement that is released with the main document and has its own versioning but follows the release cycle of the main document

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A non-controlled document supplement that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not create new versions

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A request to amend an existing document without affecting the content or version history of the document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the change proposal such as pending, scheduled, or completed

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated or manual request to review and extend the validity period of a document

objs.name: invalidation_request
objs.description: A request to declare a document invalid and archive it due to loss of validity

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore a previously archived document

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature provided by workflow participants to authorize document actions

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: User who provided the signature

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the signature was applied

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of users and user groups authorized to receive a document and participate in acknowledgement workflows

attributes.name: email_notification
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether users receive email notification on document release

attributes.name: acknowledgement_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether users must actively confirm receipt of the document

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: An assigned action in the document approval or acknowledgement process that a user must complete

attributes.name: task_type
attributes.description: Type of task such as creator signature, review, release, or acknowledgement

attributes.name: assigned_user
attributes.description: User responsible for completing the task

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the task such as pending, completed, or rejected

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined document structure that can be selected when creating new documents of a specific type

attributes.name: template_format
attributes.description: Office format such as Word, Excel, or PowerPoint used for the template

objs.name: organizationalunit
objs.description: A department, location, or functional area within the organization that can be referenced by documents

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A business risk that can be linked to documents for governance purposes

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Reference information that can be linked to documents such as IT applications, companies, or organizational units
